prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (hint, redesign), choose_path (copy, hint, new_screen), finish (incentive, layout, redesign), and sign_in (copy, hint, layout, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test.
adoption copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, and home wait_info changes each have at least 2 tests agreeing that no clear effect was seen.
home new_flow and sign_in notification changes can be helpful since at least 1 test won for each kind, though other tests showed no clear effect.
Most changes tested so far (23 out of 27 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated impact for most tests, but underestimated the size of major wins.

0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Dock Pre-Summon Interactive Flow: Inserts an interactive preview screen before waiting completes where users test dragging and waking their pet on a simulated desktop bar. (why: Home drop-off takes a median of 201s and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or interact with the pet once spawned.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Commands Summary Screen: Adds a final orientation screen listing key desktop hotkeys and tray menu options before closing onboarding. (why: Finish screen takes a median 395s / mean 5815s with 3 support tickets regarding post-onboarding pet control confusion.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Desktop Environment Diagnostics Info: Shows live diagnostic status messages while preparing the pet on desktop during the waiting screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing or app failing to launch, while waiting screen has 201s median time.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Processing Time Hint: Adds an explanatory hint below path selection indicating photo pets take 1-2 minutes while presets are instant. (why: Median choose_path duration is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating uncertainty before selection.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Welcome Copy Refresh: Updates home intro headline and body text to clearly explain how to summon the pet to active focus. (why: 3 support emails asked how to find or display pets after onboarding completion.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Notification Sound: Plays an audio chime and shows a desktop toast notice when background pet generation completes. (why: Lessons show home notification changes can be helpful, and mean waiting time is 2336s.)
